# Non-generated CMM runtime behavior.
# CMM registration remains generated by the Visual Editor.
# This file only handles performance warnings and safe fallback resets.

# Performance-warning callbacks kept as scripted effects because the generated
# nve__cmm_effects callback may call them when the matching CMM setting changes.
no_void_economy__nve_debug_audit_debug_audit_debug_messages_settings_on_changed = {
	modeu5_refresh_configuration_from_cmm_country_scope = yes
}

no_void_economy__nve_debug_audit_debug_audit_monthly_stock_check_settings_on_changed = {
	modeu5_refresh_configuration_from_cmm_country_scope = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable_map = cmm
			is_key_in_variable_map = {
				name = cmm
				target = flag:no_void_economy__nve_debug_audit_debug_audit_monthly_stock_check_settings
			}
			"variable_map(cmm|flag:no_void_economy__nve_debug_audit_debug_audit_monthly_stock_check_settings)" = 2
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = modeu5_cmm_warning.2
	}
}

no_void_economy__nve_debug_audit_debug_audit_save_mode_settings_on_changed = {
	modeu5_refresh_configuration_from_cmm_country_scope = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable_map = cmm
			is_key_in_variable_map = {
				name = cmm
				target = flag:no_void_economy__nve_debug_audit_debug_audit_save_mode_settings
			}
			"variable_map(cmm|flag:no_void_economy__nve_debug_audit_debug_audit_save_mode_settings)" = 3
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = modeu5_cmm_warning.3
	}
}

# Compatibility stubs for generated CMM callbacks. Runtime package selection is
# owned by the launcher/playset, so these callbacks must not mutate gameplay.
nve_cmf_activate_no_void_economy = {
}

nve_cmf_activate_good_decay = {
}

# Refreshes a script-safe UI marker from the CMM main NVE dropdown.
#
# common/scripted_guis is not allowed to compare CMM value links directly:
#
#   "variable_map(cmm|flag:<setting>)" > 0
#
# That form produces invalid-left-side / unset-scope errors during scripted GUI
# evaluation. Keep the CMM value-link read in a normal scripted effect, then let
# scripted_guis read this simple derived marker.
#
# Visibility policy:
#
#   unset/default -> visible, because nve_general_gameplay_country_level_stocks_countries_have_own_stocks_settings default_index = 1
#   value 1       -> visible
#   value 2       -> visible
#   value 3       -> hidden
modeu5_refresh_nve_main_cmm_visibility = {
	remove_global_variable = modeu5_cmm_nve_main_enabled

	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable_map = cmm }
		}
		set_global_variable = modeu5_cmm_nve_main_enabled
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				is_key_in_variable_map = {
					name = cmm
					target = flag:no_void_economy__nve_general_gameplay_country_level_stocks_countries_have_own_stocks_settings
				}
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = modeu5_cmm_nve_main_enabled
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			"variable_map(cmm|flag:no_void_economy__nve_general_gameplay_country_level_stocks_countries_have_own_stocks_settings)" = 1
		}
		set_global_variable = modeu5_cmm_nve_main_enabled
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			"variable_map(cmm|flag:no_void_economy__nve_general_gameplay_country_level_stocks_countries_have_own_stocks_settings)" = 2
		}
		set_global_variable = modeu5_cmm_nve_main_enabled
	}
}

# CMM's normal bool/dropdown widgets are disabled through CMMCanEditSetting.
# Mark planned services as requiring unrestricted tools so normal players see
# them as unavailable without relying on generated scripted_gui is_valid blocks.
modeu5_cmm_mark_planned_services_restricted = {
	cmm_set_requires_unrestricted_tools_enabled = {
		mod_id = no_void_economy
		setting_id = nve_economic_balance_design_activate_goods_decay_settings
	}
	cmm_set_requires_unrestricted_tools_enabled = {
		mod_id = no_void_economy
		setting_id = nve_general_gameplay_gameplay_trade_rework_settings
	}
	cmm_set_requires_unrestricted_tools_enabled = {
		mod_id = no_void_economy
		setting_id = nve_war_subjects_balance_balance_shorter_wars_settings
	}
	cmm_set_requires_unrestricted_tools_enabled = {
		mod_id = no_void_economy
		setting_id = nve_general_gameplay_gameplay_war_exhaustion_political_pressure_settings
	}
	cmm_set_requires_unrestricted_tools_enabled = {
		mod_id = no_void_economy
		setting_id = nve_economic_balance_balance_increased_location_specialisation_settings
	}
	cmm_set_requires_unrestricted_tools_enabled = {
		mod_id = no_void_economy
		setting_id = nve_economic_balance_design_sliders_adjustments_settings
	}
	cmm_set_requires_unrestricted_tools_enabled = {
		mod_id = no_void_economy
		setting_id = nve_general_gameplay_other_extra_revenue_to_ai_settings
	}
	cmm_set_requires_unrestricted_tools_enabled = {
		mod_id = no_void_economy
		setting_id = nve_war_subjects_balance_balance_adjust_rebel_threshold_settings
	}
	cmm_set_requires_unrestricted_tools_enabled = {
		mod_id = no_void_economy
		setting_id = nve_war_subjects_balance_design_overlord_declares_war_settings
	}
	cmm_set_requires_unrestricted_tools_enabled = {
		mod_id = no_void_economy
		setting_id = nve_war_subjects_balance_design_persistence_of_resources_settings
	}
	cmm_set_requires_unrestricted_tools_enabled = {
		mod_id = no_void_economy
		setting_id = nve_general_gameplay_gameplay_empire_military_difficulties_settings
	}
	cmm_set_requires_unrestricted_tools_enabled = {
		mod_id = no_void_economy
		setting_id = nve_economic_balance_balance_marketplace_burgher_power_reduction_settings
	}
}

# Silent fallback reset for planned services. If a setting still gets toggled
# through a stale UI state, a debug tool, or an unrestricted-tools session, reset
# it to the disabled/default value without showing a popup.
modeu5_cmm_reset_activate_goods_decay_setting = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable_map = cmm
			is_key_in_variable_map = {
				name = cmm
				target = flag:no_void_economy__nve_economic_balance_design_activate_goods_decay_settings
			}
		}
		remove_from_variable_map = {
			name = cmm
			key = flag:no_void_economy__nve_economic_balance_design_activate_goods_decay_settings
		}
	}
}

modeu5_cmm_reset_trade_rework_setting = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable_map = cmm
			is_key_in_variable_map = {
				name = cmm
				target = flag:no_void_economy__nve_general_gameplay_gameplay_trade_rework_settings
			}
		}
		remove_from_variable_map = {
			name = cmm
			key = flag:no_void_economy__nve_general_gameplay_gameplay_trade_rework_settings
		}
	}
}

modeu5_cmm_refresh_nve_main_enabled = {
	modeu5_refresh_nve_main_mode_from_cmm_country_scope = yes
}

modeu5_handle_cmm_runtime_callback = {
	modeu5_refresh_configuration_from_cmm_country_scope = yes

	switch = {
		trigger = var:cmf_callback

		flag:no_void_economy__nve_general_gameplay_country_level_stocks_countries_have_own_stocks_settings = {
			modeu5_cmm_refresh_nve_main_enabled = yes
		}

		flag:no_void_economy__nve_debug_audit_debug_audit_debug_messages_settings = {
			no_void_economy__nve_debug_audit_debug_audit_debug_messages_settings_on_changed = yes
		}

		flag:no_void_economy__nve_debug_audit_debug_audit_monthly_stock_check_settings = {
			no_void_economy__nve_debug_audit_debug_audit_monthly_stock_check_settings_on_changed = yes
		}

		flag:no_void_economy__nve_debug_audit_debug_audit_save_mode_settings = {
			no_void_economy__nve_debug_audit_debug_audit_save_mode_settings_on_changed = yes
		}

		flag:no_void_economy__nve_economic_balance_design_activate_goods_decay_settings = {
			modeu5_cmm_reset_activate_goods_decay_setting = yes
		}

		flag:no_void_economy__nve_general_gameplay_gameplay_trade_rework_settings = {
			modeu5_cmm_reset_trade_rework_setting = yes
		}

		flag:no_void_economy__nve_war_subjects_balance_balance_shorter_wars_settings = {
			modeu5_cmm_reset_shorter_wars_setting = yes
		}

		flag:no_void_economy__nve_general_gameplay_gameplay_war_exhaustion_political_pressure_settings = {
			modeu5_cmm_reset_war_exhaustion_political_pressure_setting = yes
		}

		flag:no_void_economy__nve_economic_balance_balance_increased_location_specialisation_settings = {
			modeu5_cmm_reset_increased_location_specialisation_setting = yes
		}

		flag:no_void_economy__nve_economic_balance_design_sliders_adjustments_settings = {
			modeu5_cmm_reset_sliders_adjustments_setting = yes
		}

		flag:no_void_economy__nve_general_gameplay_other_extra_revenue_to_ai_settings = {
			modeu5_cmm_reset_extra_revenue_to_ai_to_compensate_for_lack_of_strategy_setting = yes
		}

		flag:no_void_economy__nve_war_subjects_balance_balance_adjust_rebel_threshold_settings = {
			modeu5_cmm_reset_adjust_rebel_threshold_setting = yes
		}

		flag:no_void_economy__nve_war_subjects_balance_design_overlord_declares_war_settings = {
			modeu5_cmm_reset_overlord_declares_war_setting = yes
		}

		flag:no_void_economy__nve_war_subjects_balance_design_persistence_of_resources_settings = {
			modeu5_cmm_reset_persistence_of_resources_setting = yes
		}
	}
}
